mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, the weather at Verona Area High School is currently 59 degrees with overcast skies.

Starting September 23, the city is beginning chip seal road maintenance on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and within the Liberty Business Park. Drivers should expect lane closures and traffic control between 9 AM and 3 PM on Verona Avenue, so please use caution in those work zones.
There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and live music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can head over to Insight Wellness for a yoga session.

Looking at the most recent police activity, on September 5, officers responded to a string of reports involving slices of cheese being placed on car windshields across several streets in a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare.
If you are craving a sweet treat, Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, ready to serve up today's flavor of the day until they close at 10:00 PM.
